findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "pricebee" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product · Public sink: get_mobile_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product · Public sink: get_mobile_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
